entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-19
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Q: Contrasting efcore with NHibernate re: inverse bidirectional parent-child collections #37209
  • Deleting item from JSON-owned collection with nested owned relational children throws: '__synthesizedOrdinal' is read-only after it has been saved #37208
  • ComplexCollection (JSON) + QueryFilter on child entity → "Invalid column name '...'" when Parent.Include(Child) and FK nullable #37205
  • EF.Parameter or setting ParameterTranslationMode.Parameter doesn't work with IEnumerable with nullable type #37204

Closed

  • Add dictionary navigation support #37174
  • Mixing Views into Table-Per-Concrete-Type #37203
  • Precompiled Model, Migrations, and Complex Annotations #37118
  • [release/8.0] Re-enable NuGet Audit #37034
    8.0.x
  • Support .NET 10 MemoryExtensions.Contains with equality comparer in EF 8 and 9 #37176
    9.0.x

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Switch back to net8.0 for tools #37207

Merged
